# Journal of Medical Internet Research (JMIR)

> JMIR is a leading open-access publisher of peer-reviewed journals focused on digital health, ehealth, medical informatics, and internet-based health interventions.

JMIR Publications operates a portfolio of specialized journals covering diverse areas of digital health research, from mobile health and artificial intelligence to mental health and geriatric care. All journals are open-access and indexed in major databases including PubMed, MEDLINE, Scopus, and Web of Science.

## Key Topics

- open-access journals
- peer-reviewed research
- digital health
- ehealth
- medical informatics
- mobile health (mHealth)
- artificial intelligence
- health technology
- telemedicine
- medical devices
- internet interventions
- public health surveillance
- clinical informatics
- health informatics
- gamification

## Flagship Journal

- [Journal of Medical Internet Research](https://jmir.org): Flagship open-access peer-reviewed journal on digital health and ehealth research

## Core Specialty Journals

- [JMIR AI](https://ai.jmir.org): Peer-reviewed journal on artificial intelligence and medical informatics
- [JMIR mHealth and uHealth](https://mhealth.jmir.org): Peer-reviewed journal on mobile health and ubiquitous computing research
- [JMIR Mental Health](https://mental.jmir.org): Open-access journal on digital mental health and internet interventions
- [JMIR Medical Informatics](https://medinform.jmir.org): Open-access journal on clinical informatics, EHRs and health technology
- [JMIR Public Health and Surveillance](https://publichealth.jmir.org): Open-access journal on public health informatics and digital epidemiology
- [JMIR Formative Research](https://formative.jmir.org): Peer-reviewed journal for formative research, pilot and feasibility studies

## Clinical and Health Domain Journals

- [JMIR Medical Education](https://mededu.jmir.org): Open-access peer-reviewed journal on digital learning in medical education
- [JMIR Human Factors](https://humanfactors.jmir.org): Healthcare journal on human factors, usability design and medical devices
- [JMIR Serious Games](https://games.jmir.org): Peer-reviewed journal on gamification, serious games and game-based health
- [JMIR Cardio](https://cardio.jmir.org): Open-access peer-reviewed journal on cardiovascular digital health
- [JMIR Diabetes](https://diabetes.jmir.org): Open-access journal on diabetes digital health and wearable technology
- [JMIR Cancer](https://cancer.jmir.org): Open-access peer-reviewed journal on cancer care and survivorship

## Specialized Population and Technology Journals

- [JMIR Aging](https://aging.jmir.org): Open-access journal on digital health technologies for older adults
- [JMIR Pediatrics and Parenting](https://pediatrics.jmir.org): Open-access journal on pediatric digital health and parent education
- [JMIR Rehabilitation and Assistive Technologies](https://rehab.jmir.org): Peer-reviewed journal on rehabilitation, assistive tech and telehealth
- [JMIR Dermatology](https://derma.jmir.org): Open-access peer-reviewed journal on teledermatology and digital health

## Additional Research Journals

- [Online Journal of Public Health Informatics](https://ojphi.jmir.org): Peer-reviewed open-access journal on public health informatics research
- [JMIRx Med](https://xmed.jmir.org): Diamond open-access overlay journal for peer-reviewed medical research

## Optional

- [JMIR Publications Career Center](https://careers.jmir.org): Job board and career center for JMIR Publications medical positions
